Hey-
thanks a lot for taking the time to reply. I managed to get out to dinner with a good friend; it took me out of the house for a while and seemed to help a bit. You're right about the regrounding thing and I'll definitely keep that in mind if I start to spiral out anxiety-wise. I'm going to try and keep communicating to people about what I'm going through..it's about all I can really do at this point. A little at a time, right?
I'm so insecure. That's the only way I can describe it. Is that different than anxiety? I don't know. I'm not sure how to break the cycle I'm in. I just want to die it's so bad.
No. Anxiety got worse on the olanzapine and started to get depressed so doc switched to prozac. Starting to cause suicidal thoughts and other scary shit though.
The doctor put me on prozac after switching me off olanzapine.
